program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((colors (unique (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0))
                                          (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                                     (map (lambda (c) (at g r c))
                                                          (range 0 w)))
                                                   (range 0 h)))))
                  (n (length colors)))
             (if (<= n 1) g (build-grid (* h n) (* w n) (r c) (at g (/ r n) (/ c n))))))))
